Winter Hold

You close your hand slowly. Frost thickens around your enemy’s limbs as they struggle to keep moving.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Knowledge

Target / range / shape: One visible creature within 5 squares

Proposed NPC defense attribute: Agility.

- Weak: 4 cold damage; Freezing 1. - Standard: 4 cold damage; Freezing 2. - Strong: 6 cold damage; Freezing 2 and Paralyzed 1.

Duration: Instant

Equipment / acquisition: None.

---

Tier / minimum level: 7 · DP: 8 · Requirements to learn: Frost 3

Type: Magic / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

ID: winter-hold
